data.narrative:
Firestorm Labs is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $60M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private comparables include Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $82M total-raised proxy as a base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to the next funding stage, yielding $164M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparable set identifies a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. The peer distribution reflects significant variance within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $139M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied value of $582M. The wide dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects material uncertainty around Firestorm Labs' positioning relative to more mature Series B peers in the comp set. Key sensitivities include the company's revenue traction, customer concentration within defense verticals, and technology differentiation relative to named competitors. Additional revenue or deployment metrics would narrow this range materially.
